--- title: "O' Linguafraudator" date: "2026-08-07" description: "" draft: false coverImage: "/images/posts/linguafraudator/1.jpg" tags: - şiir - linguafraudator - thisisafraud --- À la Lingua Franca, emsalleri beynelmilel
Fâni satırlar seyyahı, Dil Cambazı namıdiğer
O' Linguafraudator! Düşürme elinden kalemini
Keep hold of it, sana yegâne sığınak lisan-ı hiyel Kâtipler nezdinde namın çoktan firari
İhtimal ki, şimdi derdest ederler mi?
And then a loud scream!
Mr. Prosecutor! They are running away!
Sir, no! You were not supposed to look that way! Belki hiciv, belki şiir or some prose
Cliché, banal, oh, they are all gross!
Throw 'em away, and here comes a thunk!
Make a twist, Pro-se-cutor
For the holy sake of l'harmonica de la langue
